title: Avatar: Seven Havens Is Avoiding The Legend of Korra’s Biggest Mistake
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens has wrapped up the first season of its run with Paramount+, and the producers behind it all have revealed how the series is set to avoid The Legend of Korra ‘s biggest mistake thanks to having a full plan laid out in mind. Avatar: Seven Havens has introduced Pavi’s path for the future with its finale as she now needs to unlock all seven of her chakras and explore the other six Havens. It’s a story that’s set to be told through four seasons now in production .

Avatar: Seven Havens has been confirmed through to Season 4 when it’s all said and done , and producers Michael DiMartino and Sehaj Sethi confirmed that these four seasons will entirely wrap the story. But in speaking with GamesRadar+ , it’s been revealed by DiMartino that production on this new series is already avoiding The Legend of Korra’s biggest obstacle as it’s laid out with a four season plan in mind rather than coming up with it on the fly with each new season by comparison.

Avatar: Seven Havens Is Being Planned Across Multiple Seasons

“This one was designed more with a clear end, kind of the way we did with Avatar[: The Last Airbender], where we had pitched the whole story out,” DiMartino stated. When comparing Avatar: Seven Havens’ production to The Legend of Korra ‘s , the franchise co-creator explains how the team has a better plan of attack this time around. “Then when we did Korra, we only thought we were going to do one season, so we designed it a little differently, so if that’s all there was, it was a good little one-season story, but then we had the opportunity to do more.”

But as DiMartino explained, when the team came back to Avatar Studios to develop more projects, they gravitated toward multi-season stories, “When we came back to do the movie [Avatar: Aang] and these shows, we went back to what we’re naturally drawn to, which is this big epic story [told] over multiple seasons. So that’s our goal.” But working towards this endpoint in mind has already set a more clear path for Avatar: Seven Havens to follow compared to its more built season by season predecessor.

What Does This Mean for Avatar: Seven Havens ‘ Future?

“This is a thing [DiMartino and Konietzko] have always done, and I really agree with, is finding your story, finding your endpoint, and always working towards that,” producer Sehaj Sethi elaborated on further. “So whether or not they gave us the seasons, we knew where we were going, and we weren’t going to adjust that depending on whether or not they gave us one, two, or four seasons.” Which also likely means set developments fans can look forward to seeing with each new season as they arrive.

Avatar: Seven Havens is currently in the works on Books 2-4 of the animated series, with Book Two confirmed for another set of 13 episodes. It has yet to confirm its release date with Paramount+ as of this time, but the producers have teased some of the big developments coming in the new season like seeing more of Korra and Asami’s future after The Legend of Korra .

How are you liking Avatar: Seven Havens compared to The Legend of Korra after its debut season? What are you hoping to see before it all ends?

HT – GamesRadar+

title: After 5 Years, Dandadan Finally Reveals Okarun’s Tragic Origin Story
content:
DAN DA DAN has been working its way through one of its most divisive arcs for the past few months, and it has all led to the reveal of Okarun’s truly heartbreaking origin story after five long years. Yukinobu Tatsu’s original manga series has blown to a whole new level of popularity in the last few years thanks to the success of its TV anime adaptation , but it really hasn’t been the same for the manga. Fans really have been debating its quality for the past year’s worth of chapters.

DAN DA DAN has been in a rather chaotic arc as many new foes with strange powers of their own have started attacking Okarun and the others in order to steal their abilities. Okarun himself has been without Turbo Granny’s power for quite some time, and that has led to him nearly transforming into a deadly oni thanks to a secret dark plan. But the newest chapter of the series really digs into his rage and reveals just how terrible his life was before Momo Ayase came into his life.

DAN DA DAN Chapter 252 Reveals Okarun’s Heartbreaking Past

DAN DA DAN has never been shy about the fact that Okarun had been troubled and lonely before crossing paths with Momo in the earliest chapters, but Chapter 252 is the first real time the series actually dives into his past. Titled “Ken Takakura,” it’s revealed that his mother had separated from his father while he was very young. Okarun was given the choice to live with his mother and her new family, but he realized that it wasn’t what his mother wanted at all as she blissfully left the young boy behind. Then he spent most of his time alone.

He spent most of his young life alone, and was bullied every day by the other kids. And when his father was around, his own depressing circumstances led him to taking it out on Okarun. The young boy had been abused both at home and school, and only found refuge in a sudden magazine about aliens that gave him something to look forward to. He was hoping to make friends with aliens because he felt that was the only way he’d survive, and was at the point where he wanted to harm himself or others. But that was until Momo came along and changed everything as seen in the series’ earliest chapters.

What Does This Mean for Okarun’s Future?

With the reveal of Okarun’s backstory, it’s all part of an effort to save him from the oni influence steadily taking over his body. It had been planted there as a way to eventually draw out an apparent latent aspect of Turbo Granny’s power when it disappeared, but now that doesn’t seem to be the case. But also it’s an image of Turbo Granny seemingly helping Okarun get back himself after going berserk. It’s just a matter of whether or not he can truly overcome his past.

As Momo is still without her memories of all the time she has spent with Okarun thus far, it’s made this all the more tragic as Okarun has been trying to keep his distance from her despite how much he loves her. But this flashback reveals it goes even deeper than that as she unknowingly saved him from a lot more than that as his life was truly messed up. But how are you feeling about this look into Okarun’s past? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Rock Band FLOW Announce U.S. Dates for New 2027 World Tour
content:
Rock band FLOW announced last Friday U.S., Latin American, and Japanese dates for its new tour titled " FLOW WORLD TOUR 2027 "ONCE IN A CENTURY"～ ANIME THE MAX!!!" The tour features songs that FLOW have performed for anime as well as songs from ONCE IN A CENTURY , their first full original album in four years. The album refers to the number "26" (which can be read in Japanese as FLOW ), for the year 2026.

The U.S. tour dates include:

• February 11 - Big Night Live in Boston

• February 13 - The Palladium Times Square at New York City

• February 14 - The Howard Theatre in Washington D.C.

• February 16 - The Neighborhood Theatre in Charlotte, NC

• February 17 - The Masquerade/Heaven in Atlanta

• February 19 - The Beacham in Orlando

• February 20 - The Parker in Fort Lauderdale, FL

• February 22 - House of Blues New Orleans in New Orleans

• February 24 - Studio at the Factory in Dallas, TX

• February 25 - Moonline in Austin, TX

• February 26 - House of Blues Houston in Houston, TX

The band will also perform at The Parking Lot at the National Football Stadium in Manuaga, Nicaragua on February 28.

Japanese tour dates include:

• January 29 - Spotify O-West in Tokyo

• February 7 - BananaHall in Osaka

• March 11 - Electric Lady Land in Aichi

• March 13 - Yebisu Ya Pro in Okayama

• March 16 - Drum Be-1 in Fukuoka

• March 17 - Kyoto Muse in Kyoto

• April 16 - Kashiwa Palooza in Chiba

• April 23 - Sendai darwin in Miyagi

The band teased more dates to come.

The band went on its first five-continent tour " FLOW World Tour: Anime Shibari 2024-2025" from July 2024-May 2025.

The group have performed theme songs for such anime as Eureka Seven , EUREKA SEVEN AO , Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion (both seasons), The Seven Deadly Sins , Naruto , Naruto Shippūden , Boruto: Naruto Next Generations , Durarara!!×2 Ketsu , Tales of Zestiria the X , Heroman , The Seven Deadly Sins: Revival of The Commandments , Samurai Flamenco , and Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods .

title: Exclusive: Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery Heads to HIDIVE in 2027, North American Premiere Set for December 5
content:
HIDIVE will distribute Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery in 2027, with the film set to have its North American premiere on December 5 at Anime Frontier in Fort Worth, Texas. Further release details will be announced at a later date.

The film premiered in Japan on October 23, 2026, and marked the first new Made in Abyss movie in six years. It continues the story following Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun , the second season of the TV anime. A second film was already confirmed to be in production .

The returning cast includes:

• Miyu Tomita as Riko

• Mariya Ise as Reg

• Shiori Izawa as Nanachi

• Misaki Kuno as Faputa

• Sumire Morohoshi as Tepaste

• Takanori Hoshino as Cravagli

HIDIVE also released an English sub version of the trailer, which Anime Corner has the exclusive opportunity to share first:

Masayuki Kojima is directing the film, with Hideyuki Kurata handling the screenplay. Yuka Kuroda and Kazuchika Kise are credited with character design, while studio Kinema Citrus is handling animation production. John Ledford, President of HIDIVE, commented on the announcement:

“We’re thrilled to be bringing the highly anticipated new movie Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery to audiences in 2027. This is a major milestone for HIDIVE and will mark a proud decade-long history as not only the international distributor of the Made in Abyss franchise but also as a streaming service — beginning in July 2017 with Made in Abyss Season 1 as one of HIDIVE’s inaugural simulcasts when it launched. Stay tuned for details on next year’s release. In the meantime, for those who haven’t experienced Made in Abyss, now is the perfect opportunity to check out the original series. It’s truly one of my personal favorites!”

Awakening Mystery follows Riko, Reg, Nanachi, and Faputa as they continue deeper into the sixth layer of the Abyss. Riko remains in search of her missing mother, the White Whistle Lyza, while returning figures and new characters become involved in the beginning of another mystery.

Made in Abyss , written and illustrated by Akihito Tsukushi, follows the descent of a girl named Riko and a robot boy named Reg into the Abyss, a massive pit filled with ancient relics and mysterious creatures. The manga is serialized on Takeshobo’s Web Comic Gamma and has over 22 million circulating copies over 15 volumes.

title: Naruto’s Live-Action Movie Gets Surprising Change Amid DC Studios Shake Up
content:
Masashi Kishimoto’s Naruto is now in the works on a new live-action movie, and it’s gotten a surprising shake up due to everything now happening with DC Studios following the Warner Bros. and Paramount merger. The recent Skydance merger came with the surprising reveal that DC Studios heads James Gunn and Peter Safran were going to be stepping down soon , and there are still lots of other elements going to be explored in the immediate fallout. As it turns out, Naruto is one of the films caught in the wake.

With Gunn and Safran stepping down, it was announced that former Marvel executive Jeremy Latcham would be taking their place as the new president and CEO of DC Studios. Latcham had a lot of other projects in the works as reported by The Hollywood Reporter , and is now working at “untangling” himself from his current works such as the new Naruto live-action movie now in development with Lionsgate and Sony Pictures . But it’s yet to be revealed how this will ultimately impact the project.

Naruto Live-Action Movie Loses Producer Ahead of Production

Naruto’ s new live-action movie is currently slated to start production in Spring 2027 with Lionsgate overseeing its domestic release and production along with Sony Pictures (who are co-financing the film) handling its worldwide launch. Latcham had been previously attached as one of the film’s producers alongside writer and directer Destin Daniel Cretton and Jeyun Munford through Hisako with Avi Arad, Ari Arad and Emmy Yu of Arad Productions. Given that the film has yet to start production it’s likely not going to result in too big of a change, but that ultimately remains to be seen.

As for what has been revealed about the new Naruto live-action movie thus far, Charles Melton has reportedly signed onto the project as Kakashi Hatake . A worldwide casting search had been launched earlier this year for Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha and Sakura Harada, but no official casting has been revealed as of this time. Cretton has been open about the fact that he had been working closely with original series creator Masashi Kishimoto, but it’s unclear what the loss of potential transition of one of its producers will mean for the final end result at this point.

Will This Harm Naruto’ s Live-Action Movie?

While it’s not clear how much Latcham’s influence will impact the upcoming Naruto live-action movie, it’s not likely that the project will be too impacted by the loss of a single producer. There are still many other names attached to it as it heads into development, and Lionsgate and Sony Pictures are investing in quite a lot to making it happen . It’s possible that the loss of yet another potential dissenting voice in room could even streamline the creative process for a better result. But the alternative could be just as true as well.

Destin Daniel Cretton has shared some special new messages for Naruto’ s live-action movie debut through the year thus far , and the writer/director has been open about his love of the original manga and desire to bring it to screen in a big way. There are all sorts of other pressures on the new movie to succeed, and it’s likely that the loss of one producer might just be one of the smaller issues its production will need to contend with in the future. There are going to be even bigger potential issues down the line, so keep an eye on this one.

How are you feeling about Naruto ‘s live-action movie so far? Will Latcham’s exit make you worry about it? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

HT – THR

title: New Code Geass Anime Reveals New Look & Cast Ahead of 2027 Release
content:
Code Geass is coming back next year with a brand new anime, and a new look has been revealed at the wild cast of new characters fans will see in action with this next generation of the franchise. Code Geass is now in the midst of commemorating the 20th anniversary of the TV anime’s original release , and with it is coming back with a brand new iteration of the franchise that looks much different than all of the other TV series and movie releases before it.

Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal is the next generation of the franchise coming in 2027 , but has revealed very little about what to expect from the new anime thus far. But with it preparing for some early preview screenings in Japan starting this January, Bandai Namco Filmworks has revealed a new poster for the coming series along with the reveal of the new voice cast behind it all as well. You can check out the new look at Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal below.

Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal Reveals New Look at 2027 Launch

Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal is officially scheduled for a release sometime in 2027 , but a more concrete release date or potential international streaming plans have yet to be announced as of this time. It’s set to have some preview screenings in Japan beginning next January, so there is a solid chance it’s going to hit much sooner within 2027 than fans might expect it to. As for what to expect from this next entry, it’s going to be a full TV series unlike some of the other Code Geass miniseries or feature film projects that have been released over the years.

Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal will be directed by Kazuya Nomura for Bandai Namco Filmworks and Sunrise with Mado Nozaki writing the scripts, Rolua handling the character designs, Yoshi. designing the Agarmatha (the mechs seen in the series), Junbun Lin overseeing the special effects, Ichinogi designing the new anime’s logo, Kengo Shigemura serving as editor, and Taro Iwashiro composing the music for it. It’s also been revealed the main duo for the cast are Ivan Shibata as Aspal and Hibiku Yamamura as Zoe, but more will be revealed at a later date.

What’s Next for Code Geass ?

Code Geass has been working through a special anniversary celebration for the past few years that has resulted in all sorts of new projects , but this is the first full TV anime series released in quite some time. It’s set in a distant future where Emperor Fokasu has been lording over the Roman Empire, and has been in the midst of a long string of wars. Aspal is a young slave meets the detached head a young woman, and the two of them spark a whole new journey that they embark on together.

Code Geass has long since left Lelouch behind following the first iteration of the series, and has instead been all about the titular power as later generations of its users end up using it for their own means. This is likely going to be the case for Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal , so what are you hoping to see in this new series? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

But with it preparing for some early preview screenings in Japan starting this January, Bandai Namco Filmworks has revealed a new poster for the coming series along with the reveal of the new voice cast behind it all as well. You can check out the new look at Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal below.
Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal Reveals New Look at 2027 Launch

contentBlocks.credit: Image Courtesy of Bandai Namco Filmworks

contentBlocks.text: Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal is officially scheduled for a release sometime in 2027 , but a more concrete release date or potential international streaming plans have yet to be announced as of this time. It’s set to have some preview screenings in Japan beginning next January, so there is a solid chance it’s going to hit much sooner within 2027 than fans might expect it to. As for what to expect from this next entry, it’s going to be a full TV series unlike some of the other Code Geass miniseries or feature film projects that have been released over the years.

Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal will be directed by Kazuya Nomura for Bandai Namco Filmworks and Sunrise with Mado Nozaki writing the scripts, Rolua handling the character designs, Yoshi. designing the Agarmatha (the mechs seen in the series), Junbun Lin overseeing the special effects, Ichinogi designing the new anime’s logo, Kengo Shigemura serving as editor, and Taro Iwashiro composing the music for it. It’s also been revealed the main duo for the cast are Ivan Shibata as Aspal and Hibiku Yamamura as Zoe, but more will be revealed at a later date.
What’s Next for Code Geass ?

Code Geass has been working through a special anniversary celebration for the past few years that has resulted in all sorts of new projects , but this is the first full TV anime series released in quite some time. It’s set in a distant future where Emperor Fokasu has been lording over the Roman Empire, and has been in the midst of a long string of wars. Aspal is a young slave meets the detached head a young woman, and the two of them spark a whole new journey that they embark on together.

Code Geass has long since left Lelouch behind following the first iteration of the series, and has instead been all about the titular power as later generations of its users end up using it for their own means. This is likely going to be the case for Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal , so what are you hoping to see in this new series? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: A Legendary Action Series Is Finally Getting an Anime After 14 Years – Watch First Look Trailer
content:
A legendary action manga is finally getting its own official anime adaptation 14 years after its original debut, and the first look has been revealed at what to expect ahead of its big debut. The Fall 2026 anime schedule has been filled with some strong new releases that are going to cap off a year of notable hits, but there’s still one new anime bringing up the rear and hoping to end the year on an even stronger note. And this new anime has had fans waiting 14 years for it.

Satoshi Mizukami’s Spirit Circle originally made its debut with Shonen Ganosha’s Young King OURs magazine in 2012, and had a solid four year run before it wrapped ten years ago. But now the franchise is coming back (following the successful debut of Lucifer and the Biscuit Hammer ‘s own anime a few years ago ) with a new revival anime series hitting screens later this December. Giving fans the first look at what to expect from the new series, you can check out the first trailer and poster for Spirit Circle below to see what it’s all about.

Spirit Circle Announces New Anime Revival After 14 Years

Spirit Circle will be making its debut sometime in December later this year, but has yet to confirm a concrete release date or international streaming plans as of the time of this writing. The new anime was directed by the late Tatsuo Sato (who also wrote the scripts for the series) for NAGOMI and EOTA, and produced by TWIN ENGINE. Assistant director Kentaro Mizuno took over duties following Sato’s passing with Satoru Fujimoto providing the character designs. The ending theme revealed in the trailer is titled “No Matter the World,” as performed by Anna Nagase.

The voice cast for Spirit Circle has been announced as well as along with performing for the ending theme, Anna Nagase also stars in the series as Kouko Ishigami. Kazuki Ura stars as Fuuta Okeya, Eri Yukimura as Rune, and Yuichi Nakamura as East. With the news of the adaptation, Mizukami revealed an official statement to help celebrate, “Spirit Circle is getting an anime adaptation! It’s a story that takes us through seven different lives, each set in a different time and place,” the creator’s statement begins.

What to Know for Spirit Circle ‘s Anime

“With seven times the usual amount of worldbuilding required and an unusual runtime that’s longer than one cour but shorter than two, bringing this story to anime was no easy task,” Mizukami noted about the work done on the new Spirit Circle anime. “I’d like to express my heartfelt gratitude to everyone on the production team who worked so hard to overcome these challenges and make this adaptation possible, and especially to Director Tatsuo Sato.

With the creator then capping it off with, “Whether you’ve read the original manga or are discovering Spirit Circle for the first time, I hope you’ll stay with us all the way to the end.” When Fuuta discovers that he can see spirits, he also find out he’s stuck in a cycle of reincarnation that he and a mysterious new force try to break out of it. But with the series kicking off this December, it won’t be too long before we see more of it in action. What do you think of Spirit Circle so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Dragon Quest RPG Mobile Game's Trailer Reveals 2027 Launch, Closed Beta Test in December
content:
The Dragon Quest franchise announced that Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle ( Dragon Quest RPG: Makai-Ju to Michibikareshi Shima ), a new game for iOS and Android devices, will launch in 2027. The company streamed an English announcement trailer:

The game's official website describe the story:

High above the world, on the floating isle of Monbelusha, the annual Ringing Feast is in full swing. But as the people offer prayers, calamity strikes without warning. The fiend Zaahl corrupts Yggdrasil, once a shining symbol of hope, into Grimvein, a cursed tree whose dark influence spreads despair far and wide. As Monbelusha crumbles, a boy plummets towards the world below. The Goddess Belusha entrusts him with a single, mysterious branch. He must now take up his calling as Warden of the World Tree and embark on a journey to save the world, soaring across the skies on the isle of the chosen.

The game features turn-based battles, multiple party members, dungeon exploration, and character progression. The game will include support for English, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese (Traditional) languages.

There will be a closed beta test from December 8-15. Applications are due on November 23.

The Dragon Quest Monsters: Super Light mobile game launched in January 2014. The game ended its service in January 2024, making it the longest running Dragon Quest smartphone game, for almost 10 years.

The Dragon Quest Dokodemo Monster Parade smartphone game, which launched in 2015, ended its service in July 2020. The Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai smartphone game launched in September 2021, and ended its service in April 2023.

Dragon Quest Tact , the franchise 's tactical, role-playing smartphone game launched for iOS and Android devices in Japan in July 2020, and saw a Western release in January 2021. The game ended service in the West in February 2024.

The global version of Dragon Quest of the Stars ( Hoshi no Dragon Quest ) smartphone role-playing game launched in February 2020. The game ended service in June 2021. The game had the largest world in the series' history, and its focus was on exploring the world and fighting monsters.

title: Sword Art Online Creator’s New Anime Confirms How Long It’s Going to Be
content:
The creator behind Sword Art Online has a new anime now airing its episodes through the Fall, and a new update has revealed just how long Devils’ Crest is going to be sticking around for. The Fall 2026 anime schedule has been packed with one major release after another, but the final of the new debuts made its premiere this month as Devils’ Crest is now on screens at last . With the premiere of its first two episodes, now the anime has given fans an even more crucial update.

To celebrate the debut of Devils’ Crest this past week , the official website behind the series has shared some special behind the scenes news about how the anime has come together. But it has also importantly confirmed that the new anime will be running for two consecutive cours in total. While a concrete episode count has yet to be revealed, this means it’s going to be running through the Fall 2026 and Winter 2027 anime schedule before it wraps up.

Devils’ Crest Confirmed for Two Consecutive Cours of Episodes

While two consecutive cours of episodes usually means that an anime will be running for at least 23-25 episodes before a season wraps, it could end up being much different for Devils’ Crest case. The anime did not premiere until this month, which makes it an entire month late compared to the rest of the ongoing Fall 2026 anime schedule . The usual Fall slate will be ending their respective runs towards the end of December, and each of them will be getting 12-13 episodes before hitting that point. But that’s probably not the case here.

Given Devils’ Crest’ s late start, it’s about four or so episodes behind. That means it likely might only have about 20 episodes or so when it wraps up its run next year. That’s also if it ends up having a full Winter 2027 cour either . But at the same time, it’s still guaranteeing that this new anime run won’t be slowing down until at least sometime early next year. There’s going to be quite a lot to break down over its debut season, and that’s plenty to be excited about.

What to Know for Devils’ Crest

If you wanted to check out Devils’ Crest as it airs its new episodes through the Fall 2026 and Winter 2027 seasons, you can now find it streaming exclusively with Prime Video worldwide . The first two episodes of the new series are available as of this time, and it features both Japanese and English language audio. The series is directed by Kenichiro Komaya for Production I.G. with Shinji Ushiro serving as chief director, Eiji Umehara providing the scripts, Yuki Hayashi composing the music, and original light novel artist Yukiko Horiguchi providing the character designs.

If you’re familiar with Reki Kawahara’s work on Sword Art Online , Devils’ Crest is going to seem even more familiar. After a group of middle school students agree to test out a new virtual reality game, they find themselves suddenly trapped within it. But this time around it’s almost as if the game world has blended into the real world, and has resulted in some bloody and brutal moments so far. But how are you liking Devils’ Crest so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Crunchyroll Streams Suikoden Anime
content:
The series began streaming with English subtitles on YouTube for free beginning on October 6 with new episodes on Tuesdays. The stream is available in North America, Latin America, the Caribbean, Ireland, parts of Africa and the Middle East, and in New Zealand and Australia. The staff have listed the full region availability on the anime's X/Twitter account in English.

Ani-One Asia has also licensed the anime.

The anime debuted on October 3 on Tokyo MX at 11:30 p.m. (10:30 a.m. EDT)

Konami describes Suikoden II :

Our story's hero and his friend Jowy are members of the Unicorn Youth Brigade, which participated in a drawn-out border dispute between the Highland Kingdom and the City-States of Jowstown. A few months earlier, a truth agreement was signed between the two forces, both of which were happy to see an end to the fighting. However, hidden under the momentary peace the fires of a new war continued to smolder

Previously announced cast members include:

• Toshiki Kumagai as Riliu

• Shimba Tsuchiya as Jowy

• Ayumi Hinohara as Nanami

• Katsuyuki Konishi as Viktor

• Yūichi Nakamura as Flik

• Taku Yashiro as Luca Blight

• Chika Anzai as Jillia Blight

• Akihiro Mine as Rowd

• Tsukino Chikasada as Pilika

• Ayumu Murase as Luc

• Takeo Ōtsuka as Shu

• Yoshino Aoyama as Apple

• Masato Niwa as Mukumuku

• Jun Kasama as Culgan

• Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Seed

• Megumi Han as Leknaat

• Shōta Hayama as Gengen

• Ryūnosuke Watanuki as Rikimaru

• Saya Hitomi as Rina

• Mizutama Umino as Eilie

• Yūsuke Sasaki as Bolgan

• Jin Yamanoi as Agares Blight

• Miyuki Sawashiro as Anabelle

• Kōdai Sakai as Jess

Yūzō Satō (credited as just YUZO on the anime's English website) is directing the anime at KONAMI animation , the game studio's anime studio. NBCUniversal Entertainment Japan anime and music production department member Ryō Hino serves as the producer and production manager.

Michihiro Tsuchiya ( PriPara , ClassicaLoid ) is overseeing the series scripts. Fumi Ishikawa from Konami Digital Entertainment is credited as the game character designer, Arata Suzuki from Konami Digital Entertainment is credited for the original drafts of the anime character designs, and Ryō Yamauchi ( My Master Has No Tail ; Please Put Them On, Takamine-san! ) is the anime character designer. Yoshikazu Iwanami ( Psycho-Pass , Ghost in the Shell Arise ) is the sound director, and Kōji Nakamura ( EUREKA SEVEN AO , Ping Pong live-action film) is composing the music.

Suikoden I&II HD Remaster Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars , the HD remastered release of Konami 's classic role-playing games Suikoden and Suikoden II , launched for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in March 2025.

Konami released the original game for the PlayStation in 1995, followed by the sequel game in 1998. The series has five main installments and five spinoff games.

Konami is also developing the new mobile and PC game Gensō Suikoden : Star Leap , which launched for iOS and Android on August 7 in Japan. The game is also slated for PC via Steam . The developers assured players on August 7 the will have a release in English, French, German, Korean, and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).
